story_summary: Channel 8 Night Desk Comic Page A six-panel deadpan local-news comic in which disco congestion, radio overplay, and mirror-ball maintenance are covered with full civic seriousness. Nobody in the station treats the assignment as absurd. That is the engine of the satire: every bulletin arrives in the flat, official tone of public-service media, even when the story is clearly about nightlife running the city after dark.
